title: odontadenia gracilipes
intro: Odontadenia gracilipes, commonly known as the yellow gentian, is a plant species native to tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Odontadenia gracilipes include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of skin infections, among others. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
